Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 131. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Weapon technique
Ki Cost: 12 ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Light or Finesse Melee
Weapon that you are proficient with.
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Weapon’s Range
Duration: Instantaneous
Chargeable: Yes
You make a flurrious storm of strikes against a target
in range. Roll 3 combo attack rolls dealing your
equipped weapon’s damage die on a hit.
